description:
FILED s543k (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22), the PATTERN side of #5252 (member 5 fixed the replacement side and left this one as docs/interp-scan.md documents it -- "postderef_qq is off in pattern mode ... recorded so it is a decision": perl's answer was not recorded there, it is now).  PRE-EXISTING.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 | ./runpcl):
    use v5.24;
    my $r = \"b"; my $a = ["c"]; my $x = "abc"; my $n = ($x =~ s/$r->$*/X/) ? 1 : 0;
    my $m = ("abc" =~ /$a->@*/) ? 1 : 0; print "$n $x $m\n";
        perl  1 aXc 1        PCL  0 abc 0

WHAT IT IS: ExprToCL::_gen_interp_regex_pattern scans the pattern with Pl::InterpScan::scan(in_regex => 1) WITHOUT postderef_qq, so the arrow stays pattern text.  The ONE reader of the feature at a token is now StringInterpolation::postderef_qq_active_for (s543k); the pattern's token is the m// / s/// token itself (the s543k replacement fix reads it there).  FIX DIRECTION: pass `postderef_qq => postderef_qq_active_for($node)` to the pattern scan and lower a postderef event like the dq side (its reference's own source text through _compile_ref_text_form); then docs/interp-scan.md's residue line goes.  Check the `@*` join with `$"` and `$a->@[0,1]` in a pattern.
=== DONE (s543m, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-24) ===
PERL FIRST (5.40.3, scratch/s543m/p6/m6.pl): under the feature a pattern interpolates `$r->$*` (s///), `$a->@*` (joined with $"), `$a->@[0,1]`, `$h->@{qw(k j)}`, `$a->$#*`, `$r->$*+` (the quantifier binds the interpolated text), in qr//, split and a \Q...\E; without the feature the arrow stays pattern text (`"p->" =~ /^$p->@*$/` matches); `tr` is no interpolation.  The base left the arrow literal (and died "Quantifier '+' not allowed" on `$r->$*+`).
THE FIX: InterpScan already scanned postfix derefs in both modes behind its `postderef_qq` option; the pattern side never passed it.  ONE pattern scan, ExprToCL::_pattern_events, for both pattern lowerings (_gen_interp_regex_pattern and the \Q path _regex_case_mod_pattern), asks the feature's one reader (StringInterpolation::postderef_qq_active_for) at the op's token; a `->@` form is a list joined with $" (_interp_ref_form).  PCL_OPT=-raw-slot and none run identically.  docs/interp-scan.md's residue line updated.
PROBES: 11 lines: base 0 (wrong / died), tree 10 -- the 11th is qr's stringification lacking /u under `use v5.24`, pre-existing and unrelated: filed #5402.
GUARD: Pl/t/regex-interp-01.t pd_* (10 keys; FAIL on the base).  Commit d4e5d629 (WIP 6).

FINAL SHAS (s543m, 2026-11-27, after the stacked rebase onto s543n 9a3ce86f and main 0be2848a; the notes above cite pre-rebase shas): 82ccb8ae (WIP 6).
